qualityNotes: Unable to complete after initial generation and two manual resumes. Final failure is example annotation text alignment; valid batches are preserved. Normal/Detailed teaching-depth comparison remains incomplete.

finalCases.name: ja-mv-detailed
qualityNotes: Lyrics and coherent monologue passages were selected; poetic constructions were distinguished from ordinary usage.
Two source annotations have reading gaps; another empty example annotation was repaired.
Some explanations infer rising or teasing intonation from punctuation without audio. These claims need correction or manual review; structural validation does not establish teaching correctness.

finalCases.name: ja-monologue
qualityNotes: Coherent selection, useful grammar relations and natural-looking extension examples.
Reading format passes; detailed pronunciation correctness and segmentation require native-speaker review.

finalCases.name: ko-readings
qualityNotes: Hangul readings generated for source and examples; source contains relevant sound-change spellings.
One extension exchange contains successive departure/arrival requests with uncertain turn roles; conversational naturalness needs review.

finalCases.name: en-ipa-normal
qualityNotes: Optional pronunciation was absent; valid completion with zero gaps. This case does not exercise IPA annotation output.

Source/explanation/example use appears coherent in review; format validation does not certify dialect consistency or pronunciation correctness.
